name: Latin Lovers
description: The Latin Lovers originated in Logan Square as the Haas Parkers around 1970, a crew of Puerto Rican youths who hung out at Haas Park (Fullerton & Washtenaw). In 1973, some Haas Parkers formed the Almighty Latin Lovers, founded by a member known as Lucky, based at Fullerton & Rockwell. Their early rivals included the Latin Kings, Imperial Gangsters, and Gaylords. In 1978 they joined the United Latino Organization (ULO), forging a close alliance with the Maniac Latin Disciples. In 1979, when the Maniac and Insane family structures were formalized across allied gangs, the Latin Lovers became Maniac Latin Lovers and adopted the pitchfork as a gang symbol. After a major Insane–Maniac war in early 1992, the Insane and Maniac designations became mandatory, producing the Insane Latin Lovers and Maniac Latin Lovers factions.
